slides.headline: what to say when updates go in circles
name the real problem
slides.sub: “i’m hearing a lot of detail, but i’m still not clear on what needs my help.”

slides.headline: ask for the short version
slides.sub: “give me the two minute version first. what’s done, what’s stuck, what’s next?”

slides.headline: pull out the block
slides.sub: if they keep circling, ask “what is the part that is not moving?” then wait.

slides.headline: teach the new shape
slides.sub: “next time, start with the block. then tell me what you’ve tried.” short and kind works.

slides.headline: do you have someone who talks past the point?

caption:
if you’re getting long updates and still don’t know what’s blocked, you can say that plainly. the kind move is to ask for less recap and more signal.

save this for your next rambling one on one.
